description: This is a PHP source file for the Home module in a CRM system, responsible for displaying a personalized home page block by fetching user-specific content and rendering the corresponding template.

classes.name: Homestuff
classes.description: A class responsible for handling the 'stuff' displayed on the home page, including retrieving user-specific content.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine wrapper customized for vtiger CRM, used for assigning variables and rendering templates.

methods.name: getSelectedStuff
methods.description: Retrieves the selected 'stuff' to be displayed on the home page for a specific user and type.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Assigns variables to the Smarty template engine.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the specified template using the Smarty engine.
